capabilities: Sync Mubu documents to local Markdown files
Preserve local notes outside the managed region of each file
Mirror Mubu folder hierarchy, renames, and moves
Convert outline nodes, tasks, due dates, formulas, and tables
extras: Unofficial community project not affiliated with Mubu; it relies on Mubu web interfaces that may change without notice. Desktop only; mobile is not supported.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to import or keep local Markdown copies of Mubu outline documents.

relations.evidence: The Mubu API shape was researched with reference to Navyum/chrome-extension-mubu-export

summary: One-way sync that copies Mubu outline documents into the vault as Markdown files, preserving folder hierarchy and tracking remote changes.
